observations.behavior: Adds three new endpoint configurations for BambooHR collections: timesheets, hour_entries, clock_entries, holidays, custom_fields, archived_custom_fields. These are added to BAMBOOHR_ENDPOINTS, alongside existing goal-related endpoints.
observations.posthog_connection: These endpoints allow PostHog warehouse ingestion to fetch BambooHR time-tracking and HR metadata. The connector uses pagination and ordering parameters to retrieve records. This supports warehouse users who rely on BambooHR data for historical or identity enrichment, but does not establish broader PostHog benefit.
